_notes:
VL53L0X time-of-flight distance sensor, up to about 2 m, at 0x29 (fixed at power-up). 8-bit register index; some settings are on other register pages (0xFF selects the page)
Detection: IDENTIFICATION_MODEL_ID (0xC0) = 0xEE and 0xC1 = 0xAA. identPriority 3 puts it first of the records at 0x29, as other records' detection writes (e.g. the VL6180's 16-bit index 0x0000) are register writes on a VL53L0X
Init: Pololu's vl53l0x-arduino init (ST's VL53L0X_DataInit, StaticInit and PerformRefCalibration) then continuous back-to-back ranging, using computed init values (initCode) where it reads, changes and writes back a register: first SYSRANGE_START (0x00) = 0x01 and a 50 ms pause, which stops continuous ranging left running by a previous init (the sensor may not have been power cycled) or otherwise does one harmless single-shot range, then clear the interrupt; I/O in 2V8 mode (0x89 bit 0 set); stop_variable read from 0x91 (written back to 0x91 to start ranging); MSRC and pre-range signal rate checks off (0x60 |= 0x12); final range signal rate limit 0.25 MCPS (0x44 = 0x0020); reference SPADs: the count and type (aperture or not) read from NVM (0x92, after the 0x83/0x94 strobe sequence, 0x83 read and changed twice), the reference SPAD map read from 0xB0-0xB5, and the map written back with only the first <count> good SPADs enabled, from SPAD 12 for aperture SPADs; ST's default tuning settings (vl53l0x_tuning.h); interrupt on new sample ready, GPIO active low (0x84 bit 4 cleared); the timing budget read from the sequence step timeouts (0x01, 0x46, 0x50-0x52, 0x70-0x72; about 33 ms), MSRC and TCC steps off (0x01 = 0xE8), and the final range timeout (0x71-0x72) recalculated so the budget stays the same; VHV and phase reference calibrations (a 50 ms pause each instead of waiting for the interrupt); start continuous back-to-back ranging (0x00 = 0x02)
Poll: RESULT_INTERRUPT_STATUS (0x13) and the 12 result bytes from RESULT_RANGE_STATUS (0x14-0x1F) in one read, then clear the interrupt (0x0B = 0x01). The range in mm is 0x1E-0x1F. rangeStatus is 0x14 bits 6:3: 11 is a valid range; with no target in range it is usually 4 (phase) or 6 and the range reads 8190 or 8191. fresh is 1 when a new range completed since the previous poll (0x13 bits 2:0 not 0); back-to-back ranging gives a new range about every 33 ms
Sample rate (_conf.rate) sets only the poll interval: the sensor ranges back to back whatever the rate. A longer timing budget (more accurate, slower) or a shorter one isn't an action, as the final range timeout for it is calculated from the sensor's timeouts

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-26, polling paused, single-shot ranges): the lone 0x99 moves the 8-bit register pointer to 0x99 and the 9-byte read returns ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 7f ff (0x99-0xA1, undocumented). Nothing is written, as no data byte follows. Registers 0x00-0x0F, 0x40-0x8F and 0xC0-0xC2 unchanged; ranges valid (status 0x5F) before and after, 127-161 mm before and 132-147 mm after, the same spread. Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
